The controller is based in Switzerland. This statement follows the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), because this website also addresses people in the European Union, and the Swiss Data Protection Act (DSG).

In short

This website sets no cookies, loads no fonts, scripts or images from third-party servers, and uses no analytics and no tracking. There is no contact form, no account and no newsletter. Apart from the technically necessary server logs, no data about you is created on our side.

Hosting and server logs

This website is hosted by Vercel Inc. When you open a page, your browser automatically transmits data that is written to log files:

  • IP address of the requesting device
  • date and time of the request
  • the address requested and the amount of data transferred
  • browser type and operating system
  • where applicable, the previously visited page

This processing is technically necessary to deliver the website. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR; the legitimate interest is the secure and stable operation of the site. This data is not combined with other sources.

A data processing agreement is in place with the hosting provider. Processing on servers outside the European Union cannot be ruled out. Log data is deleted after one year.

Speech input in the planning demo

The planning demo offers to take your wishes as speech instead of text. Turning speech into text is done by your browser's own speech recognition, not by this website:

  • Chrome and other Chromium browsers send the recording to Google servers for recognition.
  • Safari sends it to Apple servers.

That processing is governed by the respective provider's privacy policy. No audio reaches SmartBasket. The recognised text is evaluated in your browser only, never leaves it and is not stored.

Recording starts only after you press the button and your browser has asked for permission. The legal basis is your consent under Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR, which you can withdraw at any time by not using the feature or by revoking the microphone permission in your browser. You can type your wishes instead — nothing is sent to any third party that way.

External links

This website links to the project on GitHub. Data is only transmitted to GitHub Inc. once you follow that link, and their privacy policy applies from then on.

Your rights

You have the right to information (Art. 15 GDPR), rectification (Art. 16), erasure (Art. 17), restriction of processing (Art. 18), data portability (Art. 20) and to object to processing (Art. 21). Please write to the address above.

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority (Art. 77 GDPR) or, in Switzerland, with the Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner (FDPIC).

Changes

This statement is updated when the website changes. The version published here is the one that applies.
